body: R75 shipped (dd31b93): the full-suite command has changed - use 'python Godot/tools/run_tests.py', NOT the old 'for f in tests/*.gd' loop, which gated on exit code alone and called a dead test green (a GDScript runtime error leaves rc=0; the clobbered ArenaRig test printed 20 SCRIPT ERRORs then '0 failure(s)' then exited 0). Measured first: all 189 captured and re-judged, fails=0, no file changes status - nothing was silently dead, so the standing 189/0 was honest. New gate adds real script errors, a test's own FAIL/failures=N line while exiting 0, and silence; rc=1 and the rc=124 hang are unchanged. Godot's exit-time 'leaked at exit' and 'N resources still in use at exit' chatter is filtered - do not re-gate on grepping ERROR. --compare shows old vs new, --reclassify re-judges the last run for free. No test file was touched. CLAUDE.md Test commands block updated.
